title: A recording opens in the video editor, for real, in Next
goal: All the video editing work (timeline, cuts, transitions, speed, titles, captions, sound, export) lives in an editor a recording only opens in when a hidden setting is switched on, and it is off by default, so a person opening a recording still gets the old play-and-shorten window. Open every recording in the video editor by default in Next.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): About twenty video features (timeline, split, transitions, speed, punch-in, titles, captions, sound as a layer, video export) are on by default in Next, but all of them live in the editor that next-a-recording-is-a-document opens, and that flag is OFF by default. So a person opening a recording got the old play-and-shorten window and none of the work. Walks set the flag themselves, so nothing caught it. The user found this on 2026-09-23 and was furious: 'I can't create a layer, do transitions, split audio out'.

Root cause found in the intake window: PhotonzApp.swift:161 routes .video to ReleaseExperience.videoEditor when the flag is off. The user's dev app has the flag turned on by hand as of 2026-09-23 04:50.
acceptance: next-a-recording-is-a-document is enabledByDefaultIn [.next], and a person with no stored override opening a recording in Next gets the editor with the timeline

A unit test over FeatureCatalog fails when a flag enabled by default in a release depends on a flag that is off by default in that release; video flags declare that they depend on next-a-recording-is-a-document
A walk opens a recording WITHOUT setting any flag and photographs the timeline, the layers list with the clip in it, and the transport
The old small video window is not what any Next user reaches from opening, dropping or capturing a recording

Closing a recording you have changed never loses the change without asking: until the Command S card is answered, the close sheet says what will not be kept and offers Export. A walk edits a recording at Next defaults, closes it, and sees the sheet

log.note: Overlaps trim-becomes-a-tool-and-the-recording-window-ret (blocked on the Command S decision). Kept separate on purpose: turning the editor on by default must not wait for the Save question, the user wants to edit video now. Save/trim/window retirement stay in that task.
triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes; epic (none) -> video-editing

manager 2026-09-23: turning this on by default exposes every Next user to silent work loss. A recording document reports SaveAffordance.nothingToSave (EditorState.swift:1450), and nothingToSave.asksBeforeClosing is false (SaveAffordance.swift:54), so after this lands a person who cuts, titles or captions a recording and closes the window loses all of it without a word. The Save question itself stays with the Command S card on trim-becomes-a-tool-and-the-recording-window-ret, but not losing work silently is true under every answer on that card, so it is added to this task's acceptance. Also: the eleven trim walks listed on that task drive the old window through the harness's flag branch; expect them to move when the default flips.

when next-a-recording-is-a-document goes on by default, take the flag out of Scripts/playtest/playing-a-recording-never-blinks-walk.json: it only sets it because the editor path is off at Next defaults today

pre-build review: the only door to the old window is EditorRootView (PhotonzApp.swift); capture, history, Open and drop all go through .video window ids, so flipping the flag covers every route. Current is untouched (flag only offered in Next). Found that turning it on hides nothing but breaks two user-facing tutorials (trim-a-recording, export-a-recording wait 20s for the old window): reproduced by running tutorial-trim-a-recording-walk and tutorial-export-a-recording-walk at the new default, both failed at startGuide.
reproduced before fixing: all 20 old-window walks failed at the new default (0 passed, 20 failed) because they reach the editor instead.

shipped: flag on by default in Next; FeatureCatalog Definition.needs + dependencies(of:) + FeatureDependencyTests; ten timeline flags need the editor; SaveAffordance.changesOnlyExportKeeps + close sheet with Export…/Don't Keep/Cancel (WindowCloseConfirmation.swift); keptByExport after a finished export; TutorialGuide.retiredBy hides the two old-window guides; 20 old-window walks pinned with the flag false; 24 editor walks stop forcing it.

verified: a-recording-opens-in-the-editor-at-defaults-walk (no flags) ok with 4 real captures, sheet read back as 'Your changes to “Tutorial Sample.mp4 (Next)” will not be kept.' with [Export…] [Don’t Keep] [Cancel]; Export leaves the window open with the Export sheet; after a real export expectEdited false. 20/20 old-window walks ok pinned, 25/25 editor walks ok at defaults, 3/3 tutorial shelf walks ok. Scripts/test.sh green (9222). Load flakes in export-size tests logged on the-export-size-test-fails-about-one-run-in-thre.
